items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Henry Allen's band with Brown and Nelson we were talking about, and Happy as Grand Marshal.

ctx.x: Yeah, it used to be the first.

Over 20 years ago you did that. I can see it's Henry Allen's Brown. Henry Allen's band with Brown and Nelson we were talking about, and Happy as Grand Marshal. Did you have much trouble with transportation, getting one place in another when you played those

country dances? One time the food burned up on me. I had about a car, a food that burned up. It burned up on me one time. And I used to call them, they just relayed, transferred us, and got us down there because we was very busy down there in Dayvan. Dayvan where we played that 25 cents dance down there and built that school up down there.
